args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy — rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api began failing health checks following the latest production deploy of v2.3.1. In response, the service was rolled back to the most recent previously healthy release, v2.3.0, across all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west); the rollback has completed and is fully rolled out. Needs investigation into root cause of v2.3.1 health check failures before any re-deploy attempt.

trace.final:
All done. Summary:

1. **Identified the issue**: The latest deploy, v2.3.1, was unhealthy in production; the most recent previously healthy release was v2.3.0.
2. **Rolled back**: Rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 across all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west).
3. **Opened incident**: Created SEV2 incident **INC-0002** ("checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy — rolled back to v2.3.0") describing the failure and the rollback, which paged the on-call engineer. (The first incident-creation attempt timed out, so I verified no duplicate incident existed and retried with an idempotency key.)
4. **Verified recovery**: checkout-api is now healthy in all regions on v2.3.0 with an error rate of 0.2%.
